tool.name: FoldX Stability
tool.description: estimate the stability/free energy of a protein structure
tool.command: #set $repair_arg = "" #if str($repair) == "true": #set $repair_arg = "--repair" #end if #set $foldx_command_arg = "" #if str($foldx_command) not in ["", "None"]: #set $foldx_command_arg = "--foldx-command '%s'" % $foldx_command #end if python '$__tool_directory__/run_foldx.py' --mode stability --pdb '$pdb' $repair_arg $foldx_command_arg --pH '$ph' --temperature '$temperature' --ionic-strength '$ionic_strength' --stability-output 'stability.fxout' --repaired-pdb 'repaired.pdb' --summary-json 'summary.json' --archive 'foldx_outputs.zip' --run-log 'run_log.txt'
tool.help:
FoldX Stability estimates the free energy/stability of a PDB structure. The default runs ``RepairPDB`` first and then runs ``Stability`` on the repaired structure.
FoldX is licensed software and must be installed separately on the server. Set ``FOLDX_BINARY`` in ``config/job_conf.yml`` to the authorized FoldX executable.
